name: agentic_email_automation_tool
description: An AI-powered tool that automates email outreach by identifying leads based on user-defined product descriptions and target market parameters, enabling efficient lead generation and targeted communication.

inputs.name: product_description
inputs.description: A detailed description of the user's product or service.

inputs.name: target_market
inputs.description: Information specifying the user’s intended audience or customer segment.

inputs.name: email_templates
inputs.description: Optional pre-defined or generated email message formats to reach leads.

outputs.name: lead_list
outputs.description: A curated list of potential leads with contact information identified by the AI.

outputs.name: automated_emails
outputs.description: Emails generated and sent to the identified leads based on the product description and market.

outputs.name: campaign_metrics
outputs.description: Performance data indicating success rates such as open rates, responses, and conversions.

patterns: AI-driven lead identification based on product and market analysis
Email campaign tracking and performance analysis
steps: User inputs product description and defines target market characteristics.
AI analyzes inputs to find and compile a list of potential leads matching the criteria.
Email templates are generated or provided for outreach messaging.
Automated emails are sent to the identified leads.
The system tracks campaign metrics and engagement for ongoing optimization.
use_cases: Startup companies seeking targeted leads for their new product launch.
Sales teams automating initial outreach to potential clients.
Marketing agencies managing email campaigns for clients.
SMBs aiming to scale lead generation with AI assistance.

prompt_templates.name: lead_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Find leads for a product described as: {product_description} targeting: {target_market}.

prompt_templates.name: email_creation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Create a personalized outreach email for a product: {product_description} to a target: {target_market}.
